verdict.rationale: Vanta's docs state SDKs are generated from an OpenAPI specification (vanta-docs-43) and there's a full API reference (vanta-docs-7, vanta-docs-29), implying a machine-readable spec exists internally, but a direct probe for the spec file at all standard locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404 (vanta-probe-3), meaning no publicly downloadable spec was found. missing for 10: a publicly accessible/downloadable OpenAPI JSON/YAML file, confirmation of spec version or endpoint for direct download.
